social_circle.name: Emily Holder Martinez

background.how_they_met: Emily is Katherine's niece, the daughter of Katherine's younger brother Robert.
background.why_close: Katherine has no children of her own and treats Emily and Emily's two children as central family. Emily turns to Katherine for listening, family recipes, school and parenting updates, and occasional emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in short but affectionate bursts between work and parenting tasks. Uses photos, quick updates, and occasional heart or smile emoji, but still writes clearly enough for Katherine to follow.

shared_activities: FaceTime or Zoom calls with Emily and her children
exchanging family photos and children's school updates
talking about recipes and family history
occasional overnight visit when Emily passes through Boynton Beach
recent_text_topics: Emily's children's school schedules, homework, soccer, and online school notices.
Coordinating a possible summer visit or one-night stop in Boynton Beach.
Katherine's family memoir project, including recipes, old photographs, and names to label clearly.
Emily's work stress and Katherine's gentle listening without giving advice unless asked.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Katherine is close to her niece Emily in Tampa and that Emily has two children; Katherine says they talk about 'her children, school schedules, recipes, and sometimes her work stress.' Q48 says Katherine uses FaceTime or Zoom with Emily and her children. Q46 says Emily sometimes turns to Katherine for emotional support.

social_circle.name: Marlene Brooks

demographics.education: high school diploma with medical office training

background.how_they_met: Marlene met Katherine through the senior center walking group after Katherine moved to Boynton Beach.
background.why_close: Marlene helped Katherine feel less isolated after her retirement move and became her closest local friend through repeated morning walks, coffee, senior center activities, and mutual check-ins.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts frequently and casually, often about logistics: weather, walking times, coffee, and senior center plans. Uses short full sentences, occasional exclamation points, and practical reminders.

shared_activities: walking club on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings
coffee or splitting a muffin after walks
senior center check-ins
talking about politics, health, storms, and grandchildren
recent_text_topics: Whether the humidity is too high for a full walking loop or whether to do a shorter route.
Coffee after the 7:30 a.m. walk and whether to split a muffin.
Senior center check-in plans during storm season.
Recent conversations about race, policing, and wanting grandchildren to grow up in a more honest country.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 says Marlene invited Katherine to the walking group after Katherine moved to Boynton Beach. Q07 says Marlene is 'probably my closest local friend' and that they walk at least three mornings a week and sometimes get coffee afterward. Q44 says Marlene called Katherine during a storm scare to say the senior center had a check-in plan. Q30 says Marlene is sympathetic to the Black Lives Matter movement.

social_circle.name: Robert Holder

background.why_close: Robert is Katherine's closest immediate family member. They share childhood history, family memories, holidays, health concerns, and a steady Sunday call routine.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Prefers phone calls, but sends practical texts about call times, travel plans, health updates, and game schedules. Uses brief full sentences and rarely uses emoji.

shared_activities: Sunday afternoon calls around 4 p.m.
holiday planning for Thanksgiving and birthdays
occasional visits three or four times a year
checking on each other's health and retirement concerns
recent_text_topics: Moving their Sunday call around a Dolphins game.
Robert's heart issues and whether he has followed up with his doctor.
Possible Thanksgiving or birthday travel between Boynton Beach and Jacksonville.
Comparing notes about Medicare, open enrollment, and retirement expenses.

Q35 says Robert has had heart issues that worry Katherine. Q40 says they compare notes about health coverage during open enrollment. Q99 says Robert lived with Katherine when she was 16 and is three years younger.

shared_activities: checking on each other's homes and plants
neighborly safety check-ins
storm preparation lists
small holiday meals or local gatherings
recent_text_topics: Porch plant watering while Katherine visits family.
Whether either of them has seen the other in a day or two.
Hurricane supplies, flashlights, batteries, water, and contact sheets.
Neighborhood notices, car break-ins, lighting, and parking lot safety.

Q17 says Katherine checks on Elaine next door if she has not seen her in a day or two. Q44 says Elaine came over during Katherine's storm anxiety and helped make a checklist.

social_circle.name: Daniel Holder

background.why_close: Although Daniel is busy and somewhat distant, he still checks in by text, and Katherine values keeping ties with nieces and nephews because she never had children of her own.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and asynchronously, often with quick check-ins, links, or photos. More likely to send 'How are you doing, Aunt Katherine?' than to have a long back-and-forth.

shared_activities: family birthday texts and cards
occasional family holiday planning
tech help by text when Katherine has phone or laptop questions
brief check-ins about health, storms, and travel
recent_text_topics: Quick check-ins from Atlanta asking how Katherine is feeling.
Storm season safety and whether Katherine has her hurricane supplies ready.
Helping Katherine understand a phone setting, Facebook post, or photo attachment.
Birthday reminders and small family updates.
